title: AP-MT064-AcpAgentRegistryLane

scope.summary:
GOAL: Build the registry of ACP-launchable agents and wire the ACP lane into the production factory so an ACP agent spawn is a first-class, governed Handshake lane. Three known agents seed the registry: (1) claude-agent-acp — the Claude Code ACP adapter, npm package @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp (RENAMED from @zed-industries/claude-code-acp; the registry must recognize the legacy name as a typed migration alias, never silently), launched via node/npx with EXECUTABLE IDENTITY VERIFICATION mirroring the resolve_codex_npm_shim discipline in official_cli_bridge.rs; (2) gemini — Gemini CLI speaks ACP natively (experimental ACP flag; CliKind::GeminiCli already exists for the executable class); (3) codex — via the Zed-maintained codex ACP adapter package. Plus a config surface for OPERATOR-ADDED ACP agents (arbitrary conforming agents; 40+ exist in the July-2026 ecosystem).

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: New file src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_sessions/acp/agent_registry.rs (registry types, identity resolution/verification, config surface); a lane-wiring change in src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/production_factory.rs (extend the cloud-lane config the way it already wires the official-CLI lane, see with-official-cli builder around line ~378); a MINIMAL enum extension where the code dictates: inspect ProviderKind (src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/types.rs line ~62: Local, ExternalCompat, ByokCloud, OfficialCli) and CliKind (src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/official_cli_bridge.rs line ~63: ClaudeCode, CodexCli, GeminiCli, Other) and every exhaustive match on them, then choose and record ONE of: (a) new ProviderKind::AcpAgent variant, or (b) reuse ProviderKind::OfficialCli with an ACP transport discriminator on the lane config — the decision rule is MINIMAL DIFF ACROSS EXHAUSTIVE MATCHES while keeping FR/ledger lane labels distinguishable (an ACP spawn must never be indistinguishable from a plain official-CLI spawn in the ledger). Integration tests under src/backend/handshake_core/tests/acp_agent_registry.rs.

DETAILED SPEC:
- REGISTRY RECORD (machine-readable, serde): { agent_id (stable, kebab-case), display_name, launch: { kind: NpmShim | NativeExecutable | NodeScript, executable_or_shim_path, args, env_allowlist }, acp: { expected_capabilities, version_range }, identity: { verification_policy, pinned_sha256s? }, origin: BuiltIn | OperatorAdded, aliases: [legacy package names] }. Registry ids are referenced by MT-065/066 and by session-launch callers.
- IDENTITY VERIFICATION (claude-agent-acp exemplar, mirroring resolve_codex_npm_shim at official_cli_bridge.rs line ~1263): for an npm-shim launch on Windows, validate the shim (.cmd) by name and bounded size; parse it to confirm it dispatches to node_modules/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/<bin entry> with %* passthrough; resolve the package's package.json and require name == @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp (or a registered alias with a typed AliasResolved event) and a non-empty version; resolve the actual node entry script; capture locked FileIdentity (canonical path + sha256, via the locked_file_identity pattern line ~1084) for shim, script, manifest, and the node executable; pin identities on first registration and revalidate on every launch (mismatch => typed ExecutableIdentity error, no spawn). For NativeExecutable launches (gemini), pin the executable FileIdentity directly.
- LANE WIRING: extend the production factory cloud-lane config with an ACP lane analogous to the official-CLI lane: not configured => an ACP spawn returns the factory's honest ProviderNotConfigured error (never a silent fallback to another lane); configured => the lane builds an ACP session via the MT-061 adapter. SwarmCoordinator remains the ONLY sanctioned spawn path (WP-017 stub control): the registry/lane provides no bypass constructor that skips coordinator governance (caps, ceilings, consent, leases).
- CONFIG SURFACE: operator-added agents are declared through the same configuration mechanism the existing lanes use (inspect how the official-CLI lane receives CliBridgeConfig from operator config and mirror it); adding an agent requires launch spec + identity policy; agents with verification_policy=Pinned cannot launch unverified. Config parse errors are typed, named, and never default to a permissive launch.
- LEDGER/FR: agent registration, alias resolution, identity pin, revalidation failure, lane spawn, and lane not-configured are all typed EventLedger events with the ACP lane label; FR kinds per MT-161 when landed else DEFERRED-with-reason.

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Inspect ProviderKind and CliKind plus EVERY exhaustive match on them (grep the workspace) and write the enum-extension decision (option a or b, with the match-site list) into the code as a doc comment and into the MT lifecycle on completion.
2. Implement the registry record types + serde + stable-id validation (kebab-case, unique).
3. Implement NpmShim identity resolution for claude-agent-acp mirroring resolve_codex_npm_shim (shim parse, package manifest name/version check, entry-script resolution, node resolution) with locked FileIdentity capture and pin/revalidate lifecycle; wire the @zed-industries/claude-code-acp legacy alias with a typed AliasResolved event.
4. Implement NativeExecutable identity for gemini (direct FileIdentity pin) and NodeScript/NpmShim identity for the codex ACP adapter package.
5. Seed the three built-in registry entries with expected_capabilities (claude-agent-acp: loadSession=true expected, usage events ABSENT — known gap; gemini: native ACP; codex: adapter) and conservative version_range values; these are DECLARATIONS here — live verification is MT-066.
6. Extend the production factory cloud-lane config with the ACP lane (mirror the official-CLI lane builder pattern ~line 378) including the honest not-configured error path.
7. Implement the operator config surface for added agents, mirroring the existing lane-config ingestion path.
8. Emit the typed ledger events; wire HBR-INT-009 tier evidence.
9. Author tests per expected_tests: registry + identity verification against synthetic npm-shim fixture trees on disk (a fake shim + package layout in a temp dir — REAL file parsing/hashing, no mocked filesystem), lane not-configured honesty, no-bypass-spawn assertion.
10. Run proof targets; live-agent launches are explicitly OUT of scope here (MT-066 owns them) — do not fabricate live proof.
allowed_paths: src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/types.rs (ProviderKind extension ONLY if decision (a) is taken)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/official_cli_bridge.rs (CliKind extension ONLY if the decision requires it; no other edits)
forbidden_paths: .GOV/** (the bridge is READ-ONLY reference for parity; never edited by this WP)
src/frontend/** (no GUI surface in this MT)
acceptance_criteria: The registry holds the three built-in agents (claude-agent-acp, gemini, codex-acp-adapter) with stable ids, launch specs, expected capabilities, and identity policies; serde round-trip proven.

NpmShim identity verification for claude-agent-acp mirrors resolve_codex_npm_shim: shim parse + manifest name check (@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp) + entry-script + node resolution, all captured as locked FileIdentity (canonical path + sha256) — proven against a synthetic on-disk shim/package fixture; a tampered script or wrong manifest name yields a typed identity error and NO launch plan.

Identity pin-then-revalidate lifecycle proven: first registration pins; a subsequent resolution with changed bytes fails typed (mirror the pinned-identity revalidation in official_cli_bridge.rs ~line 2082).
The legacy package name @zed-industries/claude-code-acp resolves via a typed AliasResolved event to the renamed package — proven by test; no silent acceptance.

The enum-extension decision (ProviderKind::AcpAgent vs OfficialCli+transport discriminator) is recorded in a doc comment listing every inspected exhaustive match site, and the build stays green across the workspace (no missed match arm).
An ACP spawn on an unconfigured lane returns the factory's honest ProviderNotConfigured-class error — proven by test; no fallback to another lane.
A configured ACP lane spawn constructs the MT-061 adapter session and its ledger events carry an ACP-distinguishable lane label (never indistinguishable from plain OfficialCli) — proven by test.
No public constructor or function allows an ACP agent spawn that bypasses SwarmCoordinator governance — proven by API-surface test/review note.
Operator-added agent config: a valid declaration registers and resolves; an invalid one (bad id, missing identity policy, unparseable) fails typed — both proven.
cargo build -p handshake_core green; all listed tests pass headless.
expected_tests: acp_npm_shim_identity_verification (synthetic on-disk fixture, real parse + sha256)
implementation_notes: resolve_codex_npm_shim (official_cli_bridge.rs ~1263-1400) is the verified in-repo exemplar: shim filename check, bounded size, content dispatch check with %*, package.json name/bin verification, version extraction, platform-dependency validation, node resolution. Mirror the DISCIPLINE for @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp; the package layout differs (inspect the actual installed package at implementation time — bin entry name and platform handling are package-specific).
locked_file_identity (~1084) holds an OS file lock while hashing so the verified bytes cannot be swapped before spawn; reuse or mirror that primitive, do not downgrade to unlocked hashing.

ENUM DECISION GUARD: do NOT extend both ProviderKind and CliKind speculatively. Inspect first; extend only what the chosen option requires; the allowed_paths entries for types.rs/official_cli_bridge.rs are conditional on that recorded decision.

Gemini CLI ACP flag: research says native ACP behind an experimental flag; verify the exact flag against the installed CLI at implementation time (registry stores it as launch args data, so a flag rename is config, not code).

Expected capabilities per agent are declarations consumed by MT-066's contract tests and MT-065's parity report; keep them honest (claude-agent-acp: NO usage/cost events as of July 2026 — declare the absence, do not paper over it).
SwarmCoordinator remains the single sanctioned spawn path (WP-017 stub minimum control); the lane is plumbing UNDER the coordinator, exactly like the official-CLI lane.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless backend MT: registry + lane wiring. Operator GUI for lane management is an existing/other-family surface; this MT's config surface is file/config-based and proven via tests + TraceProjection per HBR-VIS-004.

target_entries: Agent sessions: ACP agent registry — built-in agents, how to add an operator-defined ACP agent, identity verification requirements, lane configuration

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: FLIGHT_RECORDER: agent registration, identity pin/revalidation failure, and lane spawn are business events — FR emit per MT-161 kinds when landed, else DEFERRED-with-reason.
INTERNAL_DIAGNOSTICS: expose registry state (agent count, identity pin status per agent, lane configured/unconfigured) to the open diagnostic-event API — WIRED or DEFERRED-with-reason.
PALMISTRY: not directly applicable (no long-lived process owned by this MT; sessions are MT-061's) — record NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason unless the implementation adds a resident watcher.
risk_if_missed: No governed way to launch real ACP agents: MT-065/066 have nothing to launch, operator-added agents are impossible, and any ad-hoc launch path would skip executable identity verification and SwarmCoordinator governance.

risks: RISK-1: Executable identity spoofing — an unverified npm shim or swapped entry script runs arbitrary code under Handshake's governed-agent identity (supply-chain class).
RISK-2: Silent legacy-alias acceptance — treating @zed-industries/claude-code-acp as interchangeable without a typed event hides which package actually ran.

RISK-3: Ungoverned spawn bypass — a registry/lane convenience constructor that spawns without SwarmCoordinator breaks the single-sanctioned-spawn-path invariant (privilege escalation surface named in the WP stub).

RISK-4: Enum-extension breakage — adding a ProviderKind/CliKind variant without sweeping every exhaustive match silently changes behavior at unvisited match sites, or the ACP lane masquerades as OfficialCli in the ledger making spawns unattributable to transport.
RISK-5: Permissive config fallback — a malformed operator agent declaration that defaults to launch-anyway converts a typo into an unverified agent launch.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): resolve_codex_npm_shim-grade verification + locked FileIdentity sha256 pin + revalidate-on-launch; tamper test is a named proof target.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): alias resolution is a typed AliasResolved ledger event; test asserts its presence.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): no-bypass API-surface test; lane plumbing sits strictly under SwarmCoordinator like the official-CLI lane.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): recorded enum decision with the full match-site inventory; workspace build green is an acceptance criterion; ledger lane label distinctness is a tested criterion.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): config parse errors are typed and fail registration; invalid-config test is mandatory; verification_policy=Pinned agents cannot launch unverified.

research_provenance.source: Inspected product code: official_cli_bridge.rs (CliKind ~63, resolve_codex_npm_shim ~1263, locked_file_identity ~1084, pinned-identity revalidation ~2082), model_runtime/types.rs (ProviderKind ~62), swarm_orchestration/production_factory.rs (cloud-lane config + with-official-cli builder ~378, honest ProviderNotConfigured pattern) + ACP ecosystem July 2026 (40+ agents; @zed-industries/claude-code-acp renamed to @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp; Gemini CLI native ACP; Codex via Zed adapter) per WP-017 stub research basis.
corrections: The exact ProviderKind/CliKind extension is deliberately NOT pre-decided: the code (exhaustive match inventory) dictates it; the contract binds the decision rule (minimal diff + ledger-distinguishable lane) and requires the decision be recorded.
claude-agent-acp package internals (bin entry, platform layout) must be inspected at implementation time; the codex shim exemplar transfers as discipline, not as literal paths.
Live-agent launches are excluded here (MT-066); identity verification tests run against synthetic on-disk fixtures with real parsing and hashing.
